title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Stake Increased by Nikko Asset Management Americas Inc.
text:
Nikko Asset Management Americas Inc. grew its stake in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 32.7% during the second quarter, according to the company in its most recent 13F filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The fund owned 623,693 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after acquiring an additional 153,747 shares during the quarter. Apple comprises about 3.4% of Nikko Asset Management Americas Inc.’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 4th biggest holding. Nikko Asset Management Americas Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $115,452,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission.
Several other hedge funds and other institutional investors also recently made changes to their positions in AAPL. Morse Asset Management Inc boosted its holdings in Apple by 3.7% in the first quarter. Morse Asset Management Inc now owns 29,378 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $4,929,000 after purchasing an additional 1,035 shares during the last quarter. Miracle Mile Advisors LLC raised its stake in Apple by 77.3% during the first quarter. Miracle Mile Advisors LLC now owns 98,783 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $16,574,000 after buying an additional 43,058 shares in the last quarter. UBP Investment Advisors SA raised its stake in Apple by 31.2% during the first quarter. UBP Investment Advisors SA now owns 6,196 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,040,000 after buying an additional 1,472 shares in the last quarter. River Wealth Advisors LLC raised its stake in Apple by 1.4% during the first quarter. River Wealth Advisors LLC now owns 40,153 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $6,737,000 after buying an additional 563 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Inverness Counsel LLC NY raised its stake in Apple by 29.3% during the first quarter. Inverness Counsel LLC NY now owns 217,412 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $36,477,000 after buying an additional 49,273 shares in the last quarter. 58.61% of the stock is currently owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors. In related news, Director Arthur D. Levinson sold 20,000 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Thursday, August 2nd. The stock was sold at an average price of $206.58, for a total value of $4,131,600.00. Following the sale, the director now directly owns 1,153,283 shares in the company, valued at approximately $238,245,202.14. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which can be accessed through this hyperlink . Also, SVP Angela J. Ahrendts sold 14,194 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Friday, October 5th. The shares were sold at an average price of $227.96, for a total value of $3,235,664.24. Following the completion of the sale, the senior vice president now owns 105,538 shares in the company, valued at $24,058,442.48. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Over the last 90 days, insiders sold 564,185 shares of company stock worth $124,444,213. 0.08% of the stock is owned by insiders.
AAPL opened at $219.31 on Monday. Apple Inc. has a 12 month low of $150.24 and a 12 month high of $233.47. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84, a quick ratio of 1.24 and a current ratio of 1.31. The company has a market capitalization of $1,077.94 billion, a P/E ratio of 23.81, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.69 and a beta of 1.36.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its earnings results on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 EPS for the quarter, beating the consensus estimate of $2.18 by $0.16. Apple had a return on equity of 43.50% and a net margin of 21.98%. The firm had revenue of $53.27 billion for the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $52.43 billion. During the same period last year, the firm earned $1.67 EPS. The firm’s revenue was up 17.3% compared to the same quarter last year. As a group, research analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.76 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.
Several analysts have issued reports on the company. Loop Capital upped their price objective on Apple from $195.00 to $210.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research note on Friday, July 6th. BidaskClub cut Apple from a “strong-buy” rating to a “buy” rating in a research note on Wednesday, September 12th. Morgan Stanley restated a “buy” rating and set a $247.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday, September 26th. JPMorgan Chase & Co. restated a “buy” rating and set a $272.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday, October 10th. Finally, Royal Bank of Canada restated a “buy” rating and set a $240.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, September 11th. Three analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, nineteen have assigned a hold rating and thirty have assigned a buy rating to the company’s stock. The company has an average rating of “Buy” and an average target price of $224.63.
About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
